objective: Make BUKLOD SOS activate an urgent audible nearby notification and app-wide recipient overlay with mandatory sender GPS and tightly authorized responder navigation; do not alter live production without native and backend gates.
productionBaselineEvidence: Main ecd34228dd24f07a47ba397bb1c29199aac51779 retains R1 SOS and R2 overlay; 2026-11-21 read-only MAIN audit found one active SOS marked SENT with zero nearby recipients and no push records. Dedicated Android R2 channel referenced by server but missing matching client initialization. No claim that physical push, native APK, or published OTA has changed.
chosenApproach: Create bundled sound channel buklod-emergency-v2 with per-token confirmed capability=3 and legacy channel fallback; retain root in-app Modal; enforce foreground GPS on send, targeted recipient RLS+proximity RPC, foreground opt-in presence refresh, and narrowly scoped ON_MY_WAY map handoff.
selectionRationale: Native notification channels are required for reliable Android audio delivery, but cannot be OTA-only. Explicit per-device capability avoids trying noninstalled channels. Existing app-only overlay and authenticated server fanout remain the canonical transport. Sender-informed on-the-way navigation is preferable to exposing precise location to all nearby users.
alternativeApproaches: Force Android OS-level full-screen intent over other apps, rejected due platform restrictions and disproportionate privilege
Expose sender raw GPS in ordinary push or nearby feed, rejected due privacy and safety abuse
Background GPS tracking, rejected due opt-in and R1 foreground-only constraints
Blindly route all old tokens to a new channel, rejected because missing channel silently drops pushes
preserveBehaviors: Original SOS 1800ms deliberate long press and local device confirmation remain
No public raw location or unverified viewing; exact coordinates are delivered only to a freshly eligible ON_MY_WAY responder on a deliberate action
Explicit opt-in controls presence; no background location and no re-enabling a disabled record
Existing app-wide overlay, notification UUID handoff, 45-second inbox fallback and 15-second incident refresh remain
Canonical notification webhook, anti-spam, max 5km, radius selection, expiration and zero-recipient warnings remain
Old Android tokens retain activity notification channel; no unsupported custom sound assigned to older native installations
Caller can end own SOS but recipients cannot resolve others' requests
Current Ads and global navigation regression locks remain unchanged
No live backend schema, production native APK, or OTA mutated by this DEV source change
